SUMMARY PMP-certified Delivery / Program Manager with 9+ years of experience in program governance, enterprise delivery, and transformation programs across Banking, Fintech, and Insurance domains. Expertise in managing digital platforms, Agile delivery, portfolio management, risk and compliance, and stakeholder engagement. Proven ability to lead multimillion-dollar programs ($60M+), drive AI- enabled automation, and deliver scalable, high-impact business solutions.

Delivered 15+ enterprise programs with budgets up to $60M across banking and fintech domains • Reduced manual processing effort by 30% through AI-enabled OCR automation • Improved digital funnel conversion by 25% using analytics-driven optimization • Enhanced delivery predictability through Agile governance and release planning frameworks CORE COMPETENCIES

Nov '20 - Present

Bounteous x Accolite

Gurugram, India
